description: This file contains shell functions and procedures for configuring and managing a MBIM (Mobile Broadband Interface Model) network interface using the umbim tool. It includes setup, teardown, and configuration functions, as well as external dependencies and protocol initialization.

methods.name: proto_mbim_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the MBIM protocol configuration with default parameters and settings.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_get_field
methods.description: Extracts a specific field value from the MBIM configuration string.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Sets up the MBIM network interface, calling internal setup and handling retries on failure.

methods.name: proto_mbim_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the MBIM network interface, disconnecting and cleaning up state.
